widget.name: Hidden Field — field visibility manager
widget.short_description: Hide, mask and lock amoCRM fields and pages per user
widget.description: The widget controls visibility and editability of amoCRM fields, sections and pages per user: hide a field entirely, mask the value with asterisks, lock editing, or inherit the pipeline setting. It can also hide menu items, analytics sections and pipelines. Configuration is done via a 'field x user' matrix.
